statement:
let split := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 5 z).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p%4=1); let correction := fun z : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ split z, (1 - 2/(p : ℝ)) / (1 - 1/(p : ℝ))^2;
∃ c : ℝ, 0<c ∧ Filter.Tendsto correction Filter.atTop (nhds c)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0075 · 证明模四分裂素数的局部因子修正积收敛为正数
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0075 · Prove that the local correction product over split primes has a positive limit

brief.zh: 每项等于 1−1/(p−1)²。把对数尾界到收敛的整数平方倒数和；从 p=5 开始保证真因子都严格为正。
brief.en: Each factor equals 1−1/(p−1)². Bound the log tail by a convergent sum over reciprocal integer squares. Starting at p=5 keeps each factor positive.
